blocks.title: Isomers
blocks.text: Do ya zyada compounds jin ka molecular formula aik ho lekin atoms ki tarteeb aur khasiyatein mukhtalif hon, isomers hain; is amal ko isomerism kehte hain.

items: Jab wahi atoms ya groups mukhtalif jagahon par jure hon to structural (constitutional) isomerism hoti hai: chain, position aur functional group isomers, metamers aur tautomers, jo Chemistry XI mein parhe gaye.
Jab atoms usi tarteeb se jure hon lekin khala mein mukhtalif tarteeb (mukhtalif configuration) ho to stereoisomerism hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Isomers (aik molecular formula) do mein: Constitutional (jor mukhtalif): i. Chain, ii. Position, iii. Functional, iv. Metamers, v. Tautomers; aur Stereoisomers (jor wahi, khala mein rukh mukhtalif). Stereoisomers: bond tore baghair gardish se badalte hain? No: Configurational; Yes: Conformational. Configurational: gardish ruki hui? No: Optical; Yes: Geometrical. Optical: aaina shakal par na baithne wali? Yes: Enantiomers; No: Diastereomers.
blocks.caption: Isomers ki taqseem (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chart ko oopar se neeche sawalon ki tarah parhein. Har shaakh par aik sawal likha hai aur us ke do jawab Yes/No hain. Maslan stereoisomers par sawal hai: kya yeh sirf single bond ki gardish se, koi bond tore baghair, aik doosre mein badal jate hain? Haan ho to conformational (jaise butane ki shakalein), nahi to configurational. Phir pucha jata hai ke gardish ruki hui (restricted, jaise C=C) hai ya nahi.

blocks.prompt: Ethanol aur methoxymethane dono C2H6O hain. Yeh kis qism ke isomers hain?
blocks.explanation: Constitutional (structural) isomers, khaas taur par functional group isomers: aik alcohol aur aik ether.

items: Isomers: aik molecular formula, mukhtalif tarteeb aur khasiyatein.
Constitutional: mukhtalif jor. Stereoisomers: wahi jor, khala mein mukhtalif tarteeb.
